title.native: わんだふるぷりきゅあ！

description:
Animal Town is a town where animals and people live together. Iroha loves animals and is good friends with her dog, Komugi! One day, a mysterious creature, Garugaru, wreaks havoc in the town! However, in order to protect Iroha, Komugi transformed into human form and became a Precure...! I have to save the child animal whose heart is being garugaru-ed...! Let's join forces and return the animals to Niko Garden!

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

alternative: Cure Friendy (キュアフレンディ)

node.description:
Inukai Iroha is the deuteragonist of Wonderful Precure! She is the co-leader alongside her pet dog [Cure Wonderful](https://anilist.co/character/323117/Komugi-Inukai).

Iroha adores animals and wants to befriend them all.

alternative: Cure Wonderful (キュアワンダフル)

node.description:
Inukai Komugi is the main protagonist of Wonderful Precure! Komugi's true form is of a Papillon dog; however she can transform into a human. She is the leader of the group alongside her owner [Inukai Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/323116/Iroha-Inukai).

Komugi is full of curiosity, and is a glutton. She is athletic, and loves going for walks.

Nekoyashiki Yuki is one of the four main cures in Wonderful Precure! Yuki's true form is of a cat; however she can transform into a human. As Cure Nyammy, she forms the Nyanderful Precure duo alongside her owner [Mayu Nekoyashiki](https://anilist.co/character/323119).

Yuki is gentle, yet aloof and judgmental. She is very smart, and teases Mayu about her lack of social skills.

Nekoyashiki Mayu is one of the four main cures in Wonderful Precure! As Cure Lillian, she forms the Nyanderful Precure duo alongside her pet cat, [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/323118).

Mayu is socially awkward and wants to befriend others but runs away from social interaction. She deeply cares for Yuki.

[Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/323116/Iroha-Inukai)'s classmate and childhood friend. He has a rabbit named [Daifuku](https://anilist.co/character/326088/Daifuku), and hopes to be able to communicate with him one day. He is very good at studying and has a very kind and gentle personality. When he learns about the Precure, he assists them with his extensive knowledge about animals. He tends to become shy easily when it's about his crush on Iroha.

~!He later on becomes Iroha's boyfriend.!~
[Toyama Satoru](https://anilist.co/character/326087/Satoru-Toyama)'s brave pet rabbit.

The first Niko Garden Animal to be saved by the Precure after becoming a Garugaru. He is a butler to Niko, the creator of the Niko Garden. He usually manages the Niko Garden and considers himself a capable butler, but sometimes he is a little careless. His special skill is making Niko Garden's signature tea.
Iroha's father.
Iroha's mother.
Always cute and smiling. They have very good ears and can detect a variety of sounds. The ability they give to the Precure is "improvement of hearing".
They have a slightly cool personality. They like cold places and are good at skating on ice. The ability they give to the Precure is "sliding".
Kind and dependable. They are like a big brother to everyone. They can move quickly, and their instantaneous speed is second to none. The ability they give to the Precure is "become quick".
Enthusiastic and reliable. They love muscle training and trains without fail every day. The ability they give to the Precure is "strength".
Energetic and friendly. They are the youngest Kirarin animal and when they are happy jumps up and down excitedly. The ability they give to the Precure is "jumping boost".
Entertainer who loves to amuse everyone. They are good at magic and comes up with many ways to entertain those around them. The ability they grant the Precure is "shapeshifting"
Cheeky and mischievous. They hate to lose more than anyone else, but is still loveable. The ability they give to the Precure is "shrinking".
Calm and relaxed. Always moves at their own pace. They love napping more than anything in the world. The ability they give to the Precure is "put others to sleep".
Noble and elegant. They love to dance ballet. An admirer of beauty who has a passion for all things beautiful and fancy. The ability they give to the Precure is "flight".
Mayu's father.
Mayu's mother.
A mysterious being who controls Garugaru with his voice. He hates humans and orders Garugaru to destroy them.
Homeroom teacher for 2nd year class 1.

Torame is an energetic boy who loves to be funny, and admires Gaou, often competing with Zakuro for his attention. Like his companions, he hates humans and is very stubborn.

Zakuro is a lovesick girl who adores Gaou. She hates humans and is extremely stubborn. Like her fellow wolves, she is self-righteous, believing that their harsh methods can demonstrate to animals how humans are the enemy. She is also very jealous towards happy couples, always hoping to find ways to disrupt or break them up.

She is the god-like being that created the Niko Garden. She has magical powers that the other Niko Garden and Kirarin animals do not have. She is affectionately called "Niko-sama" by everyone. Although she looks cute, she has a strong and majestic presence. Despite her strict side, she is very kind and cares for all life.

He is a kindergarten-aged boy whose antics are the basis for the series. His affectionate name is Shin-chan. He is 5 years old and loves Chocobis and an animated superhero named "Action Kamen". He is attracted to older girls and women, despite his young age. He brazenly pursues any girl who catches his eye. He shares this trait with [his father](https://anilist.co/character/33466) and paternal grandfather, but this often results in [Mom](https://anilist.co/character/7854)'s cruel punishment. The only girl he seems to really like is a college student named [Nanako](https://anilist.co/character/7865). Some of his strange activities include dressing up and mooning. In general, he is brutally honest, highly curious, and has no shame whatsoever. Ironically, there have been several instances in which his antics actually solved the problems of those around him. He also displays a surprising amount of talent at various activities including kendo. On rare occasions, he displays bouts of selfless kindness (for example, in one anime episode he saved a frog from a truck on a rainy day, getting all wet and dirty and risking Misae's ire since it was his last set of clean clothes), but these are often immediately followed by antics that negate the goodwill others feel. There are also times when Shin Chan displays a level of maturity beyond his usual self in his concern for others. For example, during the trip to Australia where he bumps into Kazama, he kindheartedly arranged for [Kazama](https://anilist.co/character/7862)'s father to play ball with his son after Shin Chan notices him being sad on the beach.

A white, fluffy puppy Shin-chan found in a cardboard box early in the series. While a beloved member of the family, he is the subject of neglect thanks to his owner's forgetfulness and short attention span. He is a very intelligent dog, often presenting logic and intellect that surpasses his human owners. As his meals from the Noharas are at best inconsistent, he has developed a talent for foraging. An oddly human-like dog, he is very responsible and painstakingly careful.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Mirai is a thirteen-year-old girl who is just about to enter junior high. She's a strange, funny, lovely and energetic girl who is interested in various things. Her stuffed bear [Mofurun](https://anilist.co/character/125950/Mofurun) that she was given by her grandmother, [Kanoko](https://anilist.co/character/305042/Yuki-Kanoko), is very important to her and she admires [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/125949/Izayoi-Liko) a lot. Her goal is to study magic she loves while trying to gain Riko's admiration. Mirai's alter ego is the legendary Cure Miracle.

Haa-chan is a baby-like fairy who appears in Mahoutsukai Precure!. She comes from the Linkle Smartbook and it is a mystery as to why she comes from it. She acts a lot like a normal toddler, always wanting to play and getting rather moody when things don't go her way. She can get rather sleepy after eating or drinking something and goes back into the Linkle Smartbook for rest.

~!Ha-chan grows up into a young girl during episode 21.!~

~!In episode 22, she debuts as her alter ego, Cure Felice, the final form that she transforms into. As a young girl, Haa-chan goes by the name Kotoha Hanami. She sometimes acts quite mature and yet still cheerful and sweet. Kotoha has been strongly influenced by both Mirai and Liko, and tend to behave in extremely similar behavior that bear resemblance of their personalities. She is optimistic and always believes in the good of people, despite her naivety getting her into troubles. Although she has an innate gift of using magic, Kotoha has no idea why or how she is talented at it.!~

~!She is later revealed to be the reincarnation and successor of Mother RaPaPa.!~

Liko is thirteen years old and attends a school in the magic world. She is quite a shy girl with a lot of self-esteem. Even though she is great at studying her magic is quite weak. She puts a lot of pressure on herself because she wants to become a respectable witch like her sister. After meeting Mirai and becoming a Pretty Cure she starts to loosen up and becomes brighter and less worrisome.

(Source: Pretty Cure Wikia)

A teddy bear who was given to [Mirai](https://anilist.co/character/125756/Mirai-Asahina) by her grandmother on her first birthday. She gained the ability to speak when Mirai became a Pretty Cure together with [Liko](https://anilist.co/character/125949/Liko-Izayoi). She ends her sentences with "~mofu". Mofurun is a warm-hearted, soft-spoken companion. She can be curious, gluttonous, and simple-minded, getting sad and worried during serious moments. She also has a responsible side, worrying about Mirai's well-being, looking after [Ha-chan](https://anilist.co/character/125937/Hachan), and helping out Mirai and Riko during their magic classes.

An athletic girl from the floating kingdom in the sky, Sky Land. Sora has trained hard everyday to become a hero like the person of her dreams who saved her when she was a child. She and [Eru](https://anilist.co/character/296120/) are staying at [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/296118/)'s house in Sorashido City. Sora transforms into the Precure of the Sky, Cure Sky.

A bird from the Puni Bird Tribe. He dreams of being able to fly, so he studies aerodynamics very hard in order to make it happen. Tsubasa is a hard worker and vows to protect [Ellee-chan](https://anilist.co/character/296120/Elleechan).

A girl who lives in Sorashido City. Mashiro is a gentle and kind girl, who knows a lot about cooking and nature. She lives with her grandmother, [Yoyo](https://anilist.co/character/301433/Nijigaoka-Yoyo), as her parents are working overseas. 

Mashiro transforms into the Precure of Light, Cure Prism.

alternative: Cure Butterfly (キュアバタフライ)

node.description: Ageha is kindhearted, sisterly and has a soft spot for younger children. Her childhood friend is [Nijigaoka Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/296118/Mashiro-Nijigaoka) and she acts as an older sister to her.

alternative: Princess Eru (プリンセス・エル)

node.description: A young princess from Sky Land. Ellee-chan came to Sorashido City with [Sora](https://anilist.co/character/296116/) after she had been kidnapped. She has the power to create the Sky Tones, which allows the Pretty Cures the ability to transform. Ellee-chan loves to say "Eru~!"

A tough guy from the Underg Empire. He believes that the strong are always right. His catchphrase is "I'm TUEEE!" 

He currently lives somewhere in Sorashido City.

A general from the Undergu Empire. Battamonda is an egocentric and laid-back villain, who doesn't like getting physical with his enemies, instead using [Ranborgs](https://anilist.co/character/298018/Ranborg) to do the fighting for him. He also prefers not to touch weaklings, thinking they're not worth the effort. Battamonda has a short temper but quickly reverts back to being calm and sultry when he realizes he's angry.
A general from the Undergu Empire and Empress Undergu's right-hand man.
Minoton is a general from the Undergu Empire, and a villain from *Hirogaru Sky! Pretty Cure*. He is a hot-blooded and prideful warrior who prefers to fight fairly.

name.native: カイゼリン・アンダーグ

node.description: Kaizerin Undergu is a main antagonist and a leader from Undergu Empire.

A second year junior high school student who loves to sing! She's always full of energy and conveys her thoughts through song. Likes “kirakkiran-ran” things that make her feel sparkly and full of joy!
A fairy that came from Kirakiland in search for "Idol Precure". She has a laid-back and relaxed personality and ends her sentences with ~pri.
